question: Amjad Ali Khan is music exponent of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarod**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Amjad Ali Khan is a legendary musician and one of the greatest exponents of the Sarod.
 
• The Sarod is a stringed instrument used in Indian classical music, known for its deep, resonant sound.
 
• Amjad Ali Khan belongs to a renowned musical family and has contributed significantly to the global recognition of Indian classical music.
 
• He has been awarded prestigious honors like the Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan.
